name: Elden Ring
description: An open-world action RPG set in the Lands Between, created by FromSoftware with worldbuilding by George R. R. Martin.

name: Baldur's Gate 3
description: A story-rich party RPG set in the Dungeons & Dragons universe, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Monster slayer Geralt of Rivia searches for his adopted daughter in a vast, war-torn open world.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open-world action-adventure set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power, glamour and body modification.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are on the run as the age of outlaws comes to an end in America's heartland.

name: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Three very different criminals plot their own chances of survival and success in the sprawling city of Los Santos.

name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
description: The open-world fantasy epic, remastered. Explore Skyrim, master shouts and face the return of the dragons.

name: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
description: A one-armed shinobi carves a path of revenge through a brutal, reimagined late-1500s Sengoku Japan.

name: Dark Souls III
description: As fires fade and the world falls into ruin, journey into a universe filled with colossal enemies and environments.

name: God of War
description: Kratos, now a father, journeys through the realms of Norse mythology alongside his son Atreus.

name: Ghost of Tsushima
description: A samurai warrior forges a new path to defend Tsushima island against the first Mongol invasion of Japan.

name: Hades
description: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash your way out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler.

name: Hollow Knight
description: Explore twisting caverns, ancient cities and deadly wastes in a hand-drawn underground kingdom of insects and heroes.

name: Celeste
description: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain in this tight platformer.

name: Stardew Valley
description: Inherit your grandfather's old farm plot and build a new life in a small town full of friendly folk.

name: Terraria
description: Dig, fight, explore and build in a 2D world where nothing is impossible.

name: Minecraft
description: Explore infinite worlds and build everything from the simplest of homes to the grandest of castles.

name: Portal 2
description: Solve physics puzzles with a portal gun alongside (or against) the deadpan AI GLaDOS, solo or in co-op.

name: Half-Life 2
description: Gordon Freeman wakes up in an alien-controlled City 17 and joins the resistance in this landmark shooter.

name: Counter-Strike 2
description: The competitive tactical shooter rebuilt on Source 2. Free to play.

name: Dota 2
description: Two teams of five heroes battle to destroy the enemy's Ancient. Free to play.

name: Disco Elysium
description: A detective RPG with no combat: interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders and decide what kind of cop to be.

name: Outer Wilds
description: Explore a solar system trapped in an endless time loop and unravel the mystery behind it.

name: Subnautica
description: Descend into the depths of an alien ocean world, gather resources and build bases to survive.

name: It Takes Two
description: A genre-bending co-op adventure for two players about a couple turned into dolls.

name: Monster Hunter: World
description: Hunt giant monsters in living, breathing ecosystems, solo or with up to three friends.

name: DOOM Eternal
description: Hell's armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer and rip and tear through demons across dimensions.

name: Rocket League
description: Soccer meets rocket-powered cars in this high-octane competitive game. Free to play.

name: Apex Legends
description: A free-to-play hero shooter where legendary characters battle for glory on the frontier.

name: Fortnite
description: Drop in, build and battle to be the last one standing. Free to play.

name: Among Us
description: Work together to prep your spaceship for departure, but beware: there's an impostor among the crew.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Step into a world of discovery, exploration and adventure across the vast fields and mountains of Hyrule.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
description: Link's adventure takes to the skies above Hyrule, with new powers to build, fuse and rewind.

name: Super Mario Odyssey
description: Join Mario and his new ally Cappy on a globe-trotting 3D adventure to rescue Princess Peach.

name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
description: Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise as you explore, create and customize.

name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
description: Race your friends or battle them in a revised battle mode on new and returning tracks.
